title: Sindh Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2002
SINDH SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy
Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st October, 2002]
No. S.Legis.1(39)/2002, dated 21-10-2002.-----The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.-----(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy
Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(ii) It shall come into force at once.

An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy
Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st October, 2002]
No. S.Legis.1(39)/2002, dated 21-10-2002.-----The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act No.VII of 1975.--In the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy Speaker's
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, in section 5, for the words "Twenty thousand two hundred and
fifty rupees and eighteen thousand" the words "thirty thousand and
five hundred and twenty seven thousand rupees" shall respectively be
substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Speakers and Deputy Speakers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 6 of Sindh Act No.VII of 1975

ORDINANCE XXXIX OF 2002
SINDH SPEAKER'S AND DEPUTY SPEAKER'S (SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXIX OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Speaker's and Deputy
Speaker's (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st October, 2002]
No. S.Legis.1(39)/2002, dated 21-10-2002.-----The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Sindh is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 6 of
Sindh Act No.VII of 1975.--In the said Act, in section 6, for subsection
(2), the following shall be substituted:--
"(2) Where the Speaker or
Deputy Speaker is not provided with an official residence or prefers to reside
in his own house or a private residence he shall respectively, be paid thirty
nine thousand and five hundred rupees and thirty five thousand rupees per
mensem, and shall, in addition, be paid a sum of sixty thousand rupees for
furnishing the house only once whether he is appointed as Minister or elected
as Speaker or Deputy Speaker for any number of occasions either during the
first tenure of the Assembly after tenth day of March, 1985, or on election of
a new Assembly.".
